title: Calendar dates
hints: `IsLeap` is one expression: `year%4 == 0 && (year%100 != 0 || year%400 == 0)`. `DaysInMonth` is a `switch month` with `case 1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10, 12:` and so on. `Compare` is `cmp.Or(cmp.Compare(a.Year, b.Year), cmp.Compare(a.Month, b.Month), cmp.Compare(a.Day, b.Day))`. `Format` uses `%04d-%02d-%02d`.

Don't step day by day. Convert a date to a **day number** (days since 0001-01-01): with `y := d.Year - 1`, the whole years before contribute `y*365 + y/4 - y/100 + y/400` days; add the months before `d.Month` and `d.Day - 1`. Then `DaysBetween` is a subtraction and `AddDays` is `fromDayNumber(dayNumber(d) + n)`.

For `fromDayNumber(n)`, start at `Date{1, 1, 1}`; skip whole 400-year cycles (each is exactly 146097 days: `Year += 400 * (n / 146097)`, `n %= 146097`), then subtract 365/366 per year while `n` is at least the year's length, then subtract month lengths, and finally `Day += n`.
